```yaml
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pytest-cov pytest-junitxml

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest --junitxml=reports/junit.xml --cov=src --cov-report=xml:reports/coverage.xml
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: src

      - name: Publish JUnit test results
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          report_paths: reports/junit.xml

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: reports/coverage.xml
          coverage-format: cobertura
          fail-ci-if-error: true

      - name: Test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: reports/junit.xml
          output: summary.md
          show: true
```
